summary: The user's Acer Predator Helios Neo 16 laptop has experienced a sudden and drastic loss of battery capacity, from 56,000mAh to 46mWh, over a short period. The issue was triggered by an unexpected calibration process that took only 1 minute.
detected_fault: A possible manufacturing issue with the battery or its calibration process could have caused the sudden loss of capacity.
suggested_solution: Contact Acer support to report the issue and request assistance with troubleshooting or replacement of the battery.
